title: 闪避
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 这本书记录了一种被动战斗技巧：闪避。
second_page: 你反复练习脚步、重心和时机，学会了在锁定战斗中避开袭来的攻击。

en_us.title: Dodge
en_us.first_page: This book records a passive combat technique: Dodge.
en_us.second_page: Through repeated practice of footwork, balance, and timing, you learn to evade incoming attacks during locked combat.
